description: This file declares the MediaFrameWriterV1 class, which implements the IMediaFrameWriter interface for writing media frames to shared memory. It includes methods for writing frame data, managing metadata, and tracking the number of frames written. The class is part of the firebolt::rialto::common namespace and references external classes such as ByteWriter and IMediaFrameWriter.

classes.name: MediaFrameWriterV1
classes.description: A class responsible for writing media frames and associated metadata into shared memory, implementing the IMediaFrameWriter interface.

methods.name: MediaFrameWriterV1
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the shared memory buffer and info.

methods.name: writeFrame
methods.description: Writes a media segment frame into shared memory.

methods.name: getNumFrames
methods.description: Returns the number of frames written so far.

methods.name: writeMetaDataGeneric
methods.description: Writes generic metadata for a media segment.

methods.name: writeMetaDataTypeSpecific
methods.description: Writes type-specific metadata for a media segment.

methods.name: writeData
methods.description: Writes the media segment data into shared memory.
